recommendation.rationale: 2 waves/week is the highest proven-sustainable pace. The 6-wave/1-day burst proved peak capacity is ENORMOUS (~5× S374 target), but sustained throughput is fundamentally different from peak throughput. At 2 waves/week with 8.5 Evaluate/wave, the 327 Evaluate gap closes in ~19 weeks — consistent with S374's ~22-week total program estimate. Three key developments since S374 strengthen this recommendation: (1) DL-031 scope collapsed from ~850→39 items (S377), removing the primary urgency driver for 3 waves/week. (2) Actual Evaluate production rate is 8.5/wave (vs S374 estimate of 5-7), reducing program length by ~15%. (3) All 6 authoring waves maintained 0-defect certification quality — proving the model can sustain quality at 2 waves/week even if multi-week endurance is not yet demonstrated. The target should be to prove 2 waves/week for 3 consecutive calendar weeks (fulfilling S374 Condition D for CONDITIONAL→YES), then reassess at S382.
recommendation.governance_guard_compatibility_note: All 6 waves passed 51/54 governance guard tests. Rule 5 batch cap (≤28) respected — actual batches are ≤5 items. Rule 2 (DL-008) enforced — zero violations. Rule 6 (DL-026) enforced since S814. Rule 9 (DL-037) enforced. Backup protocol complied. At 2 waves/week = 8 batches/week, governance overhead is ~2.3 hours/week — manageable. At 3 waves/week = 12 batches/week, governance overhead is ~3.5 hours/week — borderline.
recommendation.remaining_program_calendar_estimate: ~22 weeks at 2 waves/week to close Evaluate gap and complete archived-clone replacement. DL-035 (0.5 weeks) + DL-031 residual (0.5 weeks) + archived clones (2.5 weeks) + Evaluate gap (19 weeks). Some work can parallelize (DL-035 + Evaluate are different sections; archived clone replacement IS Evaluate production). Realistic: ~20 weeks with parallelization.

prove_out_plan.gating_criteria: Do not authorize 3 waves/week as baseline without 3 consecutive weeks at 2 waves/week first. Peak burst ≠ sustained throughput.

condition_d_assessment: PARTIAL — Peak capacity proven at 5× S374 target (32 sessions, 6 authoring waves, 119 items in 1 calendar day). Evaluate rate of 8.5/wave exceeds S374 estimate of 5-7. All 6 waves maintained 0-defect certification quality. BUT multi-week sustainability is unproven — S374 requires 2+ waves/week for 3 consecutive weeks for CONDITIONAL→YES conversion, and only 1 calendar day of execution exists. The evidence strongly supports 2 waves/week as achievable (40 items/week, manageable governance overhead). 3 waves/week lacks any sustained-evidence basis and carries compound fatigue/degradation risk over a 13+ week program. Recommendation: lock 2 waves/week as baseline, set S382 gate for 3-week sustainability proof, then consider 3 waves/week as sprint option — not as presumed-baseline.
